required_decision: Determine whether the draft is sufficiently exact, causal, reproducible, bounded, and fail-closed to freeze before any official Binance request or acquisition implementation. Return DIRECTION_ACCEPTED only if no methodological or specification revision is required; otherwise enumerate every finite exact revision in one response.
required_checks: recompute every bound byte and canonical hash and verify the exact clean review commit
verify all Phase 1, registered PTU, archive v1, and archive v2 results remain exact and ineligible
verify v3 is materially new evidence acquisition and does not seed observations from the rejected manifest
verify exact root and month-scoped listing queries retain raw bytes, decoded CommonPrefixes, ObjectRecords, pagination, ETags, sizes, last-modified values, and retrieval timestamps
verify month-scoped query and transport guards cannot resolve or return a 2026 object identity or use a full per-symbol prefix
verify ZIP/checksum retention, calculated hashes, row parsing, timestamp cutover, value checks, and cross-object conflict rules are independently reconstructable
verify missing months, daily gaps, malformed months, duplicates, revisions, renames, migrations, and symbol reuse are explicit and fail closed
verify listing, recovery, liquidity, last-bar, delisting, exact next-bar, delay, terminal, and multi-asset synchronization rules are causal and do not use future survival
verify the archive-observed claim and formal-completeness/asset-identity limitations are scientifically defensible
verify manifest and production artifact schemas, types, hashes, ordering, nullability, cardinalities, and cross-artifact arithmetic are sufficiently exact for independent audit
verify the real production probe, full run, raw-only reconstruction, representative selector, and reconciliation requirements actually close v2's production-path failure
verify sufficiency thresholds were fixed ex ante, are meaningful for a cross-sectional baseline, and cannot be weakened after observation
verify request, byte, storage, concurrency, runtime, memory, resume, retry, and blocker rules are safe and bounded without paid services or GPU use
verify implementation repair, acquisition timeout, network blocker, data no-go, audit pending, and terminal precedence cannot mislabel an implementation or infrastructure failure as economic evidence
verify DATA_CONTRACT_GO does not authorize strategy returns, model training, holdout access, promotion, trading, credentials, or capital
verify the draft stage itself made zero network, archive, market, holdout, return, model-training, backtest, GPU, mining, credential, order, and capital action
prohibited_actions: modify any repository or filesystem file
make any network request or browse any website
invoke Binance, S3, GitHub, exchange, wallet, or market-data endpoints
access, resolve, list, stat, hash, parse, or read data/raw, external market data, any 2026 market-data identity, or any holdout source
calculate returns, train a model, run a backtest, infer profitability, select a parameter, or make a performance claim
authorize implementation, acquisition, data-contract promotion, holdout opening, or capital action
use Git write, commit, push, or mutation capability
treat controller tests or prior diagnostic returns as evidence of trading profitability
required_output: One JSON object conforming exactly to the bound output schema. The reviewer must report all material revisions in this attempt so the parent can make one bounded no-data correction pass.
